name: 健康保険・介護保険 (Kyokai Kenpo health and nursing care insurance)
authority: 健康保険法 arts.40 (標準報酬月額 grades 1–50, 58,000–1,390,000), 45 (標準賞与額: the bonus with fractions under 1,000 yen dropped, at most 5,730,000 in a fiscal year), 156, 160 and 161 (the premium is the standard remuneration times the rate, borne equally) and 167 (the employer deducts the employee half from wages); 介護保険法 art.9(2) and 健康保険法 art.156(1)(i): a person aged 40 to 64 (第2号被保険者) also pays the nursing care rate, from the month in which the day before the 40th birthday falls until the month before the day before the 65th birthday (年齢計算ニ関スル法律; 健保法156条3項). Rates: 全国健康保険協会 令和7年度 (令和7年3月分から) 都道府県単位保険料率 by the employer's prefecture (company.region) — https://www.kyoukaikenpo.or.jp/about/business/insurance_rate/rate_prefectures/r07 — and the nationwide nursing care rate 1.59%. 高齢者の医療の確保に関する法律 art.50: from the 75th birthday the person leaves employee health insurance. The employee half is rounded by 通貨の単位及び貨幣の発行等に関する法律 art.3 as the 協会けんぽ table states (50 sen or less dropped, over 50 sen raised to 1 yen); the employer bears the rest of the yen-truncated total. The standard monthly remuneration is the grade the pension office decided (the HEALTH election standard_monthly_remuneration: 資格取得時決定, 定時決定 and 随時改定, arts.41–43); without it the contract monthly wage is graded (art.42 資格取得時決定). A health insurance society employer (company.facts.health_insurer SOCIETY) uses its own rates and employee share (健康保険法 arts.160(13), 160の2, 162; customer input: society_health_rate_percent, society_care_rate_percent, society_support_levy_rate_percent, society_employee_share). A month in which the insured status is both acquired and lost (同月得喪) is charged (健康保険法 art.156(3) proviso, 厚生年金保険法 art.19(2)).

refuse_when.message: Japan social insurance needs the entity region as a prefecture code (HOKKAIDO … OKINAWA): the 協会けんぽ rate and the minimum wage are set per prefecture.
Japan social insurance needs the date of birth: nursing care (40–64), welfare pension (under 70) and health insurance (under 75) are age-bounded.
Japan social insurance needs the coverage on the contract terms (statutory_work_category): SOCIAL_AND_EMPLOYMENT, SOCIAL_ONLY, EMPLOYMENT_ONLY or NONE.
A health insurance society employer needs its health and nursing care rates (company.facts society_health_rate_percent, society_care_rate_percent).

name: 厚生年金保険 (employees' pension insurance)
authority: 厚生年金保険法 art.81(4): 18.3% of the standard monthly remuneration and the standard bonus amount (fixed from September 2017), art.82: borne equally; art.20: 標準報酬月額 grades 1–32, 88,000 (under 93,000) to 650,000 (635,000 and over) — the health grade clamped to that range; art.24の4: the standard bonus is the bonus with fractions under 1,000 yen dropped, at most 1,500,000 per month of payment; art.9: an insured person is under 70 (the loss falls on the day before the 70th birthday, art.14(5), so the month it falls in is not charged, art.19(1)). Employee half rounded under 通貨の単位及び貨幣の発行等に関する法律 art.3 (50 sen or less dropped); the employer bears the rest of the yen-truncated total. The 2025 pension reform (令和7年法律第74号) raises the ceiling grade to 680,000 from September 2027, 710,000 from September 2028 and 750,000 from September 2029. A month in which the insured status is both acquired and lost (同月得喪) is charged (健康保険法 art.156(3) proviso, 厚生年金保険法 art.19(2)).

refuse_when.message: Japan social insurance needs the date of birth: nursing care (40–64), welfare pension (under 70) and health insurance (under 75) are age-bounded.
Japan social insurance needs the coverage on the contract terms (statutory_work_category): SOCIAL_AND_EMPLOYMENT, SOCIAL_ONLY, EMPLOYMENT_ONLY or NONE.

name: 子ども・子育て拠出金 (employer child contribution)
authority: 子ども・子育て支援法 arts.69–71 with 子ども・子育て支援法施行令 (rate 3.6/1000 from April 2020): the employer alone pays 0.36% of each welfare-pension-insured employee's standard monthly remuneration and standard bonus, collected with the pension premium (日本年金機構; 協会けんぽ 保険料額表 note). Per-person amounts truncated to the yen; the notice truncates the employer total. A month in which the insured status is both acquired and lost (同月得喪) is charged (健康保険法 art.156(3) proviso, 厚生年金保険法 art.19(2)).

name: 雇用保険 (employment insurance)
authority: 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 arts.11, 12(4) and 31 with the 令和7年度 rate notice (厚生労働省; 令和7年度 https://jsite.mhlw.go.jp/yamagata-roudoukyoku/koyouhoken-20250213.html, 令和8年度 https://jsite.mhlw.go.jp/yamagata-roudoukyoku/koyouhoken-20260316.html): on every wage paid (雇用保険法 art.4(4) — salary, overtime, allowances, commuting allowance and bonus), general business 5.5/1000 worker and 9.0/1000 employer; agriculture, forestry, fisheries and sake brewing 6.5/10.0; construction 6.5/11.0 (company.facts.ei_industry_class, default GENERAL). Covered: an employee of 20 or more scheduled weekly hours expected to work 31 days or more (雇用保険法 arts.4–6; terms.statutory_work_category). Worker share rounded under 通貨の単位及び貨幣の発行等に関する法律 art.3; the employer share is truncated to the yen per person (the annual declaration settles the total).

refuse_when.message: Japan social insurance needs the coverage on the contract terms (statutory_work_category): SOCIAL_AND_EMPLOYMENT, SOCIAL_ONLY, EMPLOYMENT_ONLY or NONE.

name: 労災保険 (workers' accident compensation insurance)
authority: 労働者災害補償保険法 art.3 and 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律 arts.11–12: the employer alone pays the rate the business type carries in 労働保険の保険料の徴収等に関する法律施行規則 別表第一 (令和6年4月1日改定: 2.5/1000 to 88/1000), or the merit-adjusted rate (art.12(3)), on every wage paid to every worker; an officer who is not a worker is outside it (労働基準法 art.9). The rate is the entity's notified rate (company.facts.workers_accident_rate_per_mille); none recorded refuses the run. Truncated to the yen per person; the annual declaration settles the total.

refuse_when.message: Japan workers' accident insurance needs the entity's notified rate (workers_accident_rate_per_mille) from the 労災保険率表 for its business type.

name: 一般拠出金 (asbestos relief general levy)
authority: 石綿による健康被害の救済に関する法律 arts.35 and 37 with 同法施行令 (rate 0.02/1000 from April 2014): every employer under workers' accident insurance pays 0.02/1000 of the same wages, declared and paid with the annual labour insurance declaration. Truncated to the yen per person.

name: 源泉所得税及び復興特別所得税 (salary and bonus withholding)
authority: 所得税法 arts.183, 185 and 186 with 復興財源確保法 arts.28–31 (2.1% surtax, already in the tables): salary withholding by the 2026 月額表 — 甲欄 when the employee filed the 給与所得者の扶養控除等申告書 with this employer (art.194; the INCOME_TAX election dependency_declaration_filed), computed by the 電算機計算の特例 (平成24年3月31日財務省告示第116号, 令和7年4月30日第123号改正: employment income deduction, basic deduction and 31,667 yen per 源泉控除対象配偶者・親族, then the 5.105%–45.945% schedule rounded to 10 yen; https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2026/data/18.pdf); otherwise the 乙欄 column of 平成24年財務省告示第115号 別表第一 transcribed row by row. The base is the month's salary less the employee's social insurance premiums (art.74(2)) and the non-taxable commuting allowance (art.9(1)(v), 施行令 art.20の2: the reasonable fare up to 150,000 a month; a car commuter by one-way distance band — as raised from 1 April 2025 by the order in force 20 November 2025, up to 38,700 at 55 km or more; terms.facts commute_car_km_one_way, commute_parking_fee, commute_transit_fare; NTA https://www.nta.go.jp/users/gensen/2025tsukin/pdf/01.pdf); the premiums are those charged this month (charged.month: health, nursing, support levy, pension, employment insurance). Bonus withholding by 別表第三 (賞与に対する源泉徴収税額の算出率の表): the rate set by the previous month's salary after premiums and the declared dependants, times the bonus after its premiums, truncated to the yen; where that salary is nil or the bonus exceeds ten times it, the 月額表 on one sixth of the bonus (告示115号 第3項, 賞与計算期間 6 months or less). The previous month's salary is the previous period's salary-run pay (earned.previous_month: gross less bonuses, retirement and injury payments and the non-taxable commuting allowance) less its premiums; with no previous salary the 月額表 method on one sixth applies (別表第三 備考4). Non-residents (art.212(1), 213(1)(i)): 20.42% of the salary and bonus, no deductions. An employee who filed the 従たる給与についての扶養控除等申告書 has 1,610 yen per declared dependant taken off the 乙欄 tax (月額表 備考2; INCOME_TAX election secondary_dependants).

name: 退職所得の源泉徴収 (retirement income withholding)
authority: 所得税法 arts.30, 199, 201 and 203 with 復興財源確保法 art.28: a retirement allowance (and a 解雇予告手当, 所得税基本通達30-5) is taxed apart from salary. With the 退職所得の受給に関する申告書 (art.203; the RETIREMENT_TAX election retirement_income_declaration_filed): the deduction is 400,000 a year of service up to 20 years (at least 800,000) and 700,000 a year beyond, a part year counting as a year (art.30(3), 施行令69条); half the remainder is taxed, except that for service of 5 years or less the remainder above 3,000,000 is taxed in full (art.30(4), 短期退職手当等); fractions under 1,000 yen dropped; then the 退職所得の源泉徴収税額の速算表 (5%–45% less 0–4,796,000) times 102.1%, under 1 yen truncated (https://www.nta.go.jp/publication/pamph/gensen/zeigakuhyo2026/data/18.pdf). Without the declaration: 20.42% of the payment (art.201(3)). Service is the employment's service months at the start of the payment month. A retirement caused by becoming disabled adds 1,000,000 to the deduction (art.30(6)(iii); RETIREMENT_TAX election retirement_due_to_disability); a specified officer (特定役員) of 5 years or less is taxed on the whole remainder, without halving (art.30(5); election specified_officer). Prior retirement payments in the same or earlier years are not offset.

name: 住民税 特別徴収 (resident tax special collection)
authority: 地方税法 arts.321の3, 321の4 and 321の5: the employer deducts the individual resident tax each month from June to the following May in the amounts the municipality's 特別徴収税額決定通知書 states — the June amount (which carries the rounding remainder) and the July–May monthly amount (the RESIDENT_TAX elections june_amount and monthly_amount, replaced each June by the new notice) — and pays it by the 10th of the next month. Not charged without a notice amount.
